title: Ohara Lean proof examples
summary: Small Lean proofs and consumers for commuting involutions, list transformations and HashMap updates.

license.attribution: Ohara contributors. Upstream Lean notices remain with the examples.

reuse: Download the named sources and use leanprover/lean4:v4.35.0. Compile local dependencies before the importing consumer.

List and HashMap consumers with retained check logs.
